summary: Verified category delete respawn fix + Admin Categories drag-and-drop nesting. Backend 5/5 pytest pass; frontend nesting via HTML5 DnD confirmed (source becomes child of target, persists across reload). Invalid-move (parent onto descendant) logic blocks structural change as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminCategories.jsx is 736 lines - consider splitting the tree renderer, editor form, and DnD handlers into separate components/hooks for maintainability.

handleDropOnCategory relies on state closures (draggingCategoryId). Fine today, but if future refactor moves DnD to a portal/child, prefer passing dragging id via dataTransfer.setData to avoid stale-closure bugs.
Toast component appears portal-rendered; add data-testid on toast root to make 'Invalid Move' verifiable in tests.
seed_data_creation: Test used existing seeded roots (Pudu, Avidbot). Nested Pudu under Avidbot during test; reverted state was not restored automatically. Main agent may want to re-flatten if needed. Test-created TEST_* categories were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright synthetic DragEvents dispatch works for triggering onDrop but blue ring highlight and toast visibility can't reliably be asserted via innerText because shadcn Toaster renders in a portal and React state updates lag inside synthetic dispatch. Verify functional outcome via API/DOM tree instead.
rca of the issue: N/A - both reported bugs are already fixed and verified. Delete flow strips category from products via ecommerce.delete_category(); frontend DnD sets parent_id=target on drop and calls POST /api/store/categories/reorder to persist.
